question: Which political party was in power when Sardar Swaran Singh Committee made recommendations about Fundamental Duties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian National Congress**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Sardar Swaran Singh Committee was constituted by the **Indian National Congress** government in 1976.

• It was formed during the tenure of Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi**.

• The committee was set up to study and make recommendations on **Fundamental Duties** to be included in the Indian Constitution.

• The recommendations of the committee led to the incorporation of **Fundamental Duties** in the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Fundamental Duties:**

• Fundamental Duties are a set of moral obligations for Indian citizens, which were added to the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.

• These duties are enshrined in Part IV-A of the Constitution under Article 51A.

• Initially, there were 10 Fundamental Duties, but the 86th Amendment Act, 2002 added an 11th duty.

• These duties include respect for the Constitution, the national flag, and the national anthem, promoting harmony, and preserving the rich heritage of the composite culture.

• **42nd Amendment Act, 1976:**

• This amendment is often referred to as the "Mini-Constitution" due to the extensive changes it brought to the Indian Constitution.

• It was enacted during the Emergency period under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi's government.

• Besides adding the Fundamental Duties, it also made significant changes to the Preamble and extended the duration of the Lok Sabha and State Legislatures from 5 to 6 years.

• The amendment aimed to reduce the power of the judiciary and strengthen the central government's authority.

• **Sardar Swaran Singh:**

• Sardar Swaran Singh was a prominent Indian politician and a senior leader of the Indian National Congress.

• He served as the Union Minister for various portfolios, including Defence, External Affairs, and Agriculture.

• He chaired the committee that recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution.

• His contributions to Indian politics and governance have been significant, especially during the formative years of independent India.
